run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_wiki_brancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare branching wiki files
branch_wiki_files: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to create versioned SVN copies of documentation
update_links_in_branched_files: update links in branched wiki files so internal references point to the new versioned pages
drop_wiki_suffix: drop the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename using the DropWikiSuffix helper function
